name: extreme
title: Extreme performance
description: For very old or weak TVs (1 GB of RAM or less, Mali-400/450-class GPUs, Android 7-9): cleanyourtv's layout with every animation, effect, glow, wallpaper, splash and sound off, so Home costs as little CPU, GPU and memory as possible. Pair it with scripts/extreme-performance.sh for the system side.
